title: Header-row chevron expands or collapses every customer on the current page, with matching icon and tooltip
refs: specs/sbc-sales-by-customer.md Story 8 S8-R16; S8-R17; S8-R18; S8-R19
custom_preconds: 1. Several customers are visible on the current page.
custom_steps:
1. Hover the chevron in the table header row and read the tooltip.
2. Click it and watch the customer rows.
3. Hover it again and read the tooltip, then click it again.
custom_expected:
1. With at least one visible customer collapsed, the header chevron shows the "expand" icon and its tooltip reads "Expand all."
2. Clicking it expands every customer on the current page in one action — it acts on the currently visible customers only, not the whole result set.
3. With all visible customers expanded, the icon switches to "collapse" and the tooltip reads "Collapse all"; clicking collapses them all.
